official_definition: You can set a Color(/Color2) card with Mirage effects from your Trash, without paying the cost. When you've done so, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash, and when Spirits/Ultimates are depleted, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Mirage Drain] or [Mirage Drain: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Mirage Drain]", "give [Mirage Drain]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
